metadata.title: Melancholic Sepia Portrait with Expressive Script

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned portrait of a man with long dark hair in a pensive pose, set against a chaotic, painterly abstract background. The composition is framed by two horizontal rectangular blocks containing expressive, white handwritten script.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's sharp focus versus the blurred, gestural abstraction of the background
The warmth of the sepia palette against the stark white of the typography
The geometric rigidity of the text boxes balancing the organic forms of the figure
The subject's upward gaze creating a diagonal tension across the frame
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the subject's face
Text contained within semi-opaque rectangular bars

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot; the subject occupies the middle two-thirds of the vertical space, seated with hands clasped.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes looking off-camera, highlighted by strong directional lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text block, moves down to the subject's face, follows the line of the arms to the bottom-right text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and the highly detailed, textured background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and sepia tones providing the overall mood and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cream and white highlights on the face and in the typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone brown used for the rectangular text backgrounds.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation; high value contrast between deep blacks and bright highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying baseline and slant.
letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with exaggerated ascenders and descenders
Uneven line weight suggesting hand-drawn ink
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters are larger and more gestural
Terminals end in sharp, wispy tapers

typesetting.alignment: Left-aligned in top box, right-aligned in bottom box

composition.scale: Large enough to span roughly 1/3 of the width

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for both name and title to maintain stylistic unity.
graphicDevices: Semi-opaque brown rectangular bars behind text

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the rapid, ink-on-paper feel of the original lettering.
Captures the personal, expressive nature of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned portrait of a man with long dark hair, wearing a textured striped jacket, hands clasped near his chin, looking pensively to the side. The background should be a blurred, high-contrast abstract painting with swirling, expressive strokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two horizontal brown rectangular bars: one in the top-left and one in the bottom-right. Inside these bars, place white, expressive, hand-drawn cursive script for the name and title.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/monochrome?
Does the text appear inside rectangular blocks?
Is the lighting on the face high-contrast?
Is the background sufficiently abstract and textured?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the text background bars
Slant and speed of the script lettering
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Unique brushstroke patterns in the background

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of the white script
Strong focal point on the subject's expression

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text blocks do not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the sepia tone is consistent across the entire image.
Verify the script looks authentically hand-drawn rather than like a standard computer font.
Confirm the background texture feels like a physical painting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast sepia portrait with a textured, abstract backdrop, then frame the composition using offset rectangular text blocks featuring white, gestural script.
